description: Initializes a CatBoost classification model. This component sets up the model structure but does not perform training or handle data splitting. The resulting model can be trained later using ``ml_fit``.

parameters.name: iterations
parameters.description: The maximum number of trees that can be built during the training process.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth of the trees in the CatBoost model.

parameters.name: learning_rate
parameters.description: The learning rate used for reducing the gradient step.

parameters.name: loss_function
parameters.description: The metric to use in training. `MultiClass` works for binary and multi-class problems, `Logloss` and `CrossEntropy` for binary problems only.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: The random seed used for training, for reproducibility. If not given or `null`, no seed is used and results may differ on subsequent use.

returns.description: A model object that can be trained using ``ml_fit``.
